title: ION RPC session/message domain — command index
description: JSON Schema contracts (draft 2020-12) for the session/message domain RPC commands. Each schema validates the SUCCESS response `data` payload; request params live under $defs/requestParams. Shared error envelope: {"success":false,"error":string} (host: bin/ion.rs handle_manager_command; worker: worker_rpc.rs output_error_response). Envelopes also carry id/type(/command/session) fields not contracted here.

commands.title: checkout_branch — switch current branch (append new leaf_pointer)
compact — compaction run (LLM summarizer; emergency fallback possible)
create_session — spawn a session worker (two accepted call forms, NOT unified)
delete_entries — soft delete messages (DeletionEntry)
fork — branch from a turn (leaf_pointer + label entries)
get_active_tools — active tool names
get_branches — named branches + synthesized main trunk
get_children — child sessions from SessionIndex
get_context_usage — context window water level
get_fork_messages — user inputs for fork-point selection
get_full_messages — raw in-memory Message list (thinking blocks included)
get_inflight_messages — in-memory (not yet reloaded) messages
get_last_assistant_text — bare JSON string payload
get_messages — paginated message retrieval (worker surface; get_session_messages is an alias here)
get_queue — steering / follow-up queues
get_session_info — unified session status (state + stats + tokens)
get_session_messages — HOST-level direct disk read (no worker spawn)
get_session_stats — message counts + token + lineage
get_state — worker runtime state snapshot
get_tree — session tree (three response variants by mode/emptiness)
get_tree_with_leaf — full tree + root→leaf path
get_turn_detail — full entry list + overview of one turn
list_all_sessions — disk SessionIndex catalog with lineage (lazily heals messageCount)
list_inputs — user input list (turn anchors)
list_session_turns — HOST-level direct disk read of turn overviews
list_sessions — LIVE workers keyed by session (no worker_id exposed)
list_turns — per-turn overview (worker surface; list_session_turns is an alias here)
navigate_tree — linearized navigable tree
new_session — STUB: echoes the current session id
restore_entries — undo soft delete / fold (RestorationEntry + reload)
search_sessions — search sessions by title/project (+ optional content scan)
session_remove — kill workers + index tombstone + delete JSONL files
summarize_entries — soft-fold messages into a summary (SegmentSummaryEntry)
token_usage_summary — cross-session token usage aggregated from SessionIndex

outOfScope.get_last: 无 RPC 面：`~/.ion/agent/last_session` 是 CLI 侧文件（src/paths.rs last_session_path），没有同名 RPC 命令。
outOfScope.generate_resume_prompt: 无 RPC 面：src/worker_registry.rs:8535 的内部函数（respawn/resume 时生成提示词），不经 RPC 暴露。
outOfScope.export_html: worker 侧为存根（src/worker_rpc.rs:3554 恒返回 {"path":""}），真实导出走 CLI/其他链路，暂不立契约。
outOfScope.prompt/steer/abort/continue/follow_up: 执行域命令，不在会话/消息域清单内（本批次未分配，见汇报风险点）。
